properties.html: Vidhyut appears for a Junior Math olympiad exam in which there are two sections - A and B. The first section i.e. A contains 6 questions while section B contains 9 questions. Each question in section A carries 3 marks and each question in section B carries 4 marks. There is no negative marking and no mark is deducted for any unattempted question. In how many ways can he attempt the questions such that he gets at least 10 marks in section A and his overall number of attempts (both sections combined) is 10 questions?
